Title: Counter Page
Summary: Interactive counter page demonstrating local component state and event handling.
Content:
## Counter.razor **Path:** `Components/Pages/Counter.razor` **Type:** Routable page component ### Route ```razor @page "/counter" ``` ### Content ```razor Counter

Counter

Current count: @currentCount

``` ### State | Member | Type | Description | |--------|------|-------------| | `currentCount` | `int` | The current counter value. Initialized to `0`. | ### Methods #### IncrementCount ```csharp private void IncrementCount() => currentCount++; ``` Increments `currentCount` by 1 on each button click. ### Accessibility - `role="status"` on the count paragraph ensures screen readers announce updates when the count changes. ### Notes - State is **local to the component** — it resets on page refresh or navigation. - No service dependencies — this is a self-contained demonstration component. - Uses Bootstrap `btn btn-primary` styling.
